notifications.name: Vanilla
notifications.danger: According to the list of ingredients, the product contains 2-(4-tert-butylbenzyl) propionaldehyde (BMHCA) and 3- cyclohex-3-ene-1-carbaldehyde (HICC), which are prohibited in cosmetic products. BMHCA may harm the reproductive system, may harm the health of the unborn child and may cause skin sensitisation, while HICC may cause an allergic skin reaction. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
